narration: The Command Center is where your physical plant comes online — live HMI dashboards streamed straight from the factory floor.
The One-Board Status bar rolls up every cell from your unified namespace cache — running, blocked, faulted, or stale — at a glance.
On the left, live views map to namespace nodes — like the Conveyor fault-detective dashboard at enterprise, home garage, conveyor lab, conveyor one.
Pair an Ignition gateway with MIRA Connect and real-time telemetry lands here automatically — no proprietary software, no local install, just the browser.
Your control room, in the cloud.
